notes: Requirements come from each programme's 'organization' (course regulations) page in the course catalogue. Per-programme call-for-applications PDFs, the 'Admission requirements 2026/2027' PDF (language_requirements_sapienza_2026.pdf, academic_requirements_movein_2026-2027_web_20260608.pdf, accepted_qualifications_2026_06_26.pdf) and the course-specific calls are PDF-only and were not read. Pre-selection window (22 Dec 2025 - 15 May 2026) and Universitaly deadline (30 June 2026) are for the 2026/27 intake and already closed; the 2027/28 calendar was not yet published. Management Engineering (33512) and Electronics Engineering (33511) pages state no usable requirements. The 2026/27 non-EU pre-selection window (22 Dec 2025 - 15 May 2026) is stated on the shared 'Programmes in English' page (https://www.uniroma1.it/en/en/admissions), not on programme pages, so no per-programme deadline is recorded.
